info.title: Space Boxes V2 implemented API
info.description: Same-origin Django JSON API derived from accounts/productivity routes, views, serializers and tests at integration baseline d85353bf02f094c49c735be17598393871493398. Paths have no trailing slash. Browser session authentication, no bearer tokens. In release use HTTPS; SecurityMiddleware redirects plain HTTP with 301 before view processing. Session cookie spaceboxes_session is Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax; csrftoken is Secure/SameSite=Lax and readable by the client. Unsafe requests (including anonymous login/register/recovery/logout) require CSRF cookie plus X-CSRFToken, and a trusted Origin or HTTPS Referer. OpenAPI cookie schemes document browser behavior; interactive cross-origin tools cannot bypass CSRF. CSRF failure is HTML 403, not the ApiError JSON envelope. JSON parser accepts an empty body as {}, ignores Content-Type, and rejects non-object/invalid JSON. Extra object keys are generally ignored. GET-decorated productivity routes reject HEAD with 405; undecorated csrf/me accept HEAD. This contract documents intended valid request shapes without promising every malformed input is handled uniformly. Frontend, static files and Django admin are outside this API contract.

get.description: Sets csrftoken cookie and returns a masked token for X-CSRFToken. Refresh after registration/login, which rotate CSRF state. This view has no method decorator: GET/HEAD are documented; other methods reach the same view, with CSRF middleware for unsafe methods. No CORS endpoint is implemented.

Instant.description: Input accepts non-negative epoch milliseconds or a timezone-aware ISO datetime. Output uses integer epoch milliseconds.

Task.description: Task edits replace the planning aggregate. sessionPlan must be nonempty, positive finite minutes with unique identities. Parent must be in scope and acyclic; maximum three primary tasks per day per scope (including subtasks). Planned breaks reference adjacent current items; absent/invalid breakMinutes become null. History-referenced items must be retained or retired. Fields omitted from edits can clear their previous values. Revision metadata is returned by the server.

Part.description: Interruption requires episodeId. Unknown pause accepts only pause parts; uncertain focus accepts focus/interruption. Ordered parts must total elapsedMs; reliable durations cannot be replaced.

Session.description: Sync imports ended history only: ending and contiguous closed evidence starting at actualStart are required for a new session. Completed outcome needs sufficient confirmed focus; ended-early retains unmet focus. Embedded evidence/authorityChanges/reconciliations are import fields; output sends these as separate feed arrays. Unknown snapshot and ending-point fields are preserved. The server startingSnapshot also includes title, classification, timezone, plannedStart, plannedItemId, activeMinutes and optional parentTaskId for connected starts; imported snapshot objects are preserved rather than rebuilt.

Prefs.description: Preferences only; scheduled delivery is not implemented.

Pull.description: Records changed after since; reservation is always current. config/prefs are null when unchanged or absent. No pagination or deletion tombstones are implemented.

EvidenceClose.description: Close existing evidence once. Already closed evidence returns duplicate; uncertain focus is reclassified. No controller field is required by this sync handler.

Push.description: Independent atomic operations in list order; push referenced Plan Days/tasks before dependent records. baseRevision is used for task edits only. Matching retries return duplicate, stale task content returns conflict with canonical record. Unknown/malformed operations can be rejected inside a successful batch. Multiword kinds also accept hyphen aliases: plan-day and evidence-close.

observation.description: Optional. If nonempty, at must equal command at. Certainty defaults to confirmed; elapsedMs defaults to null. Transfer forces focus uncertainty.

FocusCommand.description: start also requires sessionId/taskId/plannedItemId/timezone/evidenceId. pause/resume/record/transfer require a fresh evidenceId unless this command completes the session; end does not. transfer requires confirmed=true and may come from an observer. reconcile requires evidenceId/elapsedMs/nonempty parts. expectedRevision must equal current focusRevision; an accepted controller is required except for start/transfer. reconcile still requires a reservation. Command UUID retries are rejected, not idempotently replayed. Invalid UUIDs and some malformed nested objects are not uniformly converted to JSON errors by the current implementation.
